# v3.9 — Advanced CSS Grid Properties Advanced Grid gives precise control for complex layouts like Nuke node graphs. ## 1. grid-auto-rows + Dense Packing ```css .dense-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); grid-auto-rows: 80px; gap: 16px; } → Items automatically fill gaps (great for node orchestration). 2. Span + Alignment Control CSS.span-3 { grid-column: span 3; } .tall { grid-row: span 2; } → Create irregular but controlled node layouts. 3. Subgrid (Future-Proof) Modern browsers support subgrid for nested alignment.
